adjudication.rationale: In `packages/emails/email-manager.ts` `sendAddGuestsEmails` iterates `calendarEvent.attendees` and does `if (newGuests.includes(attendee.email)) return sendEmail(() => new AttendeeScheduledEmail(calendarEvent, attendee)); else return sendEmail(() => new AttendeeAddGuestsEmail(calendarEvent, attendee));`. This means the newly added guests (those in `newGuests`) receive the regular `AttendeeScheduledEmail` instead of the new `AttendeeAddGuestsEmail` template introduced in this diff, which matches the finding.
